title: Tokenized stock trading hits $2.7B even though trades can cost 3% more
summary: Tokenized stocks recorded about $3 billion in decentralized-exchange transactions over seven days, according to figures reported on Nov. 4. US stocks rallied that day as Republicans lost unified control of Washington, with the S&P 500 up 1.6%, the Dow up about 3% and the Nasdaq up 1.4%.
